parameters.name: AllowShutDown
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable No-activity Suspension. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables the feature.

- **false** (default): Disables the feature.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The ID of the scheduled task.

parameters.name: ScaleApRoNumMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: ScaleApRoNumMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: ScaleMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of PCUs. Valid values: 1 to 32.

parameters.name: ScaleMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of PolarDB Capacity Units (PCUs). Valid values: 0.25 to 32. This value must be less than or equal to the value of ScaleMax.

parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: SecondsUntilAutoPause
parameters.description: The detection period for No-activity Suspension. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 5 to 1440. The value must be a multiple of 5.

parameters.name: ServerlessRuleCpuEnlargeThreshold
parameters.description: The CPU utilization threshold for a scale-up. Unit: percent. Valid values: 40 to 100.

parameters.name: ServerlessRuleCpuShrinkThreshold
parameters.description: The CPU utilization threshold for a scale-down. Unit: percent. Valid values: 10 to 100. The value of ServerlessRuleCpuEnlargeThreshold minus the value of this parameter must be greater than or equal to 30.

parameters.name: ServerlessRuleMode
parameters.description:
The scaling sensitivity. Valid values:

- normal

- flexible

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.
